results.title: FDA Approves J&J's IMAAVY For Warm Autoimmune Hemolytic Anemia
results.description: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) announced that the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) has approved IMAAVY (nipocalimab-aahu) for the treatment of warm autoimmune hemolytic anaemia (wAIHA) in adults and pediatric patients 12 years of age and older currently or previously treated with corticosteroids.
